text.zh: 有什么不明白的，点我就好~
text.en: If anything's unclear, just tap me~

text.zh: 呜哇！刚、刚才什么都没发生哦！
text.en: Whoa! N-nothing happened just now, okay?!

text.zh: ...好吧，你见证了游戏还不完善的瞬间。
text.en: ...Fine, you just witnessed a moment of imperfection.

text.zh: 恭喜获得隐藏成就：「Bug见证者」！
text.en: Congrats! Hidden achievement unlocked: "Bug Witness"!

text.zh: 又、又来了...这次我假装没看到。
text.en: A-again... I'll pretend I didn't see that.

text.zh: 放心，我已经偷偷帮你稳住了！
text.en: Don't worry, I quietly held things together!

text.zh: 开发者大概在某个深夜写下了这段代码...
text.en: The developer probably wrote this code late at night...

text.zh: 没关系，游戏还在跑着呢！继续加油！
text.en: No worries, the game's still running! Keep going!

text.zh: 早上好！今天也一起守护防线吧。
text.en: Good morning! Let's defend the line together today.

text.zh: 下午好~来一局放松一下？
text.en: Good afternoon~ How about a round to unwind?

text.zh: 晚上好！夜间战斗，别打瞌睡哦。
text.en: Good evening! Night battles await — stay sharp!

text.zh: 这么晚了还在玩...要注意休息哦。
text.en: Still playing this late... Don't forget to rest.

text.zh: 不过...能陪你打一局我也很开心。
text.en: But... I'm happy to play one more round with you.

text.zh: 已经玩了半个小时了，状态不错！
text.en: Half an hour in already — you're on a roll!

text.zh: 一个小时了！休息一下眼睛吧。
text.en: One hour! Give your eyes a break.

text.zh: ...你不休息？好吧，我陪你。
text.en: ...Not resting? Fine, I'll stay with you.

text.zh: 一个半小时了！真的该休息了...
text.en: An hour and a half! You really should take a break...

text.zh: 我都替你的眼睛担心了！
text.en: I'm worried about your eyes!

text.zh: 知道吗？不同塔的攻击方式差别很大哦~
text.en: Did you know? Different towers have very different attack styles~

text.zh: 升级比建新塔更划算，记住了吗？
text.en: Upgrading is more cost-effective than building new. Got it?

text.zh: 道具要用在关键时刻，别浪费了~
text.en: Save items for key moments — don't waste them~

text.zh: Boss关之前多准备准备...
text.en: Prep well before the Boss wave...

text.zh: 我最喜欢看你连杀的样子了！
text.en: I love watching you chain kills!

text.zh: 你说...这些敌人为什么要排着队走过来呢？
text.en: Say... why do enemies just line up and walk toward us?

text.zh: 它们就不能绕路吗？想不通。
text.en: Can't they take a detour? Makes no sense.

text.zh: 有时候我觉得，防守也是一种哲学。
text.en: Sometimes I think defense is a kind of philosophy.

text.zh: 在对的地方放对的东西，然后静静等待。
text.en: Put the right thing in the right place, then wait.

text.zh: 今天天气怎么样？
text.en: How's the weather today?

text.zh: ...啊，我只能看到这个战场。
text.en: ...Oh right, all I can see is this battlefield.

text.zh: 塔放在路口能打到更多敌人，这是基本功哦。
text.en: Placing towers at intersections hits more enemies — that's the basics!

text.zh: 你有没有想过...我不说话的时候在想什么？
text.en: Ever wonder... what I'm thinking when I'm quiet?

text.zh: 答案是在想下次说什么。
text.en: The answer is: what to say next.

text.zh: 听说厉害的指挥官都喜欢少建塔、多升级。
text.en: I heard top Commanders prefer fewer towers and more upgrades.

text.zh: 质量比数量重要~
text.en: Quality over quantity~

text.zh: 如果现实生活也能「暂停」就好了...
text.en: If only real life had a "pause" button...

text.zh: 考试之前暂停复习一百年！
text.en: Pause before exams and study for a hundred years!

text.zh: 每座塔都有自己的个性，就像每个人一样。
text.en: Every tower has its own personality, just like people.

text.zh: 你知道吗，我其实很怕Boss...
text.en: You know, I'm actually scared of Bosses...

text.zh: 但有你在我就不怕了！大概吧。
text.en: But with you here, I'm not afraid! ...Probably.

text.zh: 人生就像塔防——
text.en: Life is like tower defense —

text.zh: 你永远不知道下一波会来什么。
text.en: You never know what the next wave will bring.

text.zh: 但只要做好准备，就没什么好怕的。
text.en: But as long as you're prepared, there's nothing to fear.

text.zh: 散射攻击打群怪超好用，试过吗？
text.en: Scatter attacks are great against groups — tried them?

text.zh: 好安静...敌人是不是迷路了？
text.en: So quiet... Did the enemies get lost?

text.zh: 选能力的时候别光看颜色。
text.en: Don't pick abilities just by color.

text.zh: 有些绿色能力搭配好了比紫色还强！
text.en: Some green abilities combo better than purple ones!

text.zh: 我刚在想...如果我也能变成一座塔...
text.en: I was just thinking... what if I could become a tower...

text.zh: 算了，站着不动太无聊了。
text.en: Nah, standing still would be so boring.

text.zh: 你觉得先存钱还是先建塔？
text.en: Save up gold first, or build towers right away?

text.zh: 我觉得都行，关键是要有计划。
text.en: Either works, as long as you have a plan.

text.zh: 隐身的敌人最讨厌了，塔还打不到它们...
text.en: Stealthed enemies are the worst — towers can't even hit them...

text.zh: 我偷偷告诉你，开发这个游戏的人...
text.en: I'll tell you a secret — the person who made this game...

text.zh: 据说经常通宵。真是辛苦呢。
text.en: Apparently pulls all-nighters a lot. What dedication.

text.zh: 失败了也没关系，每次都能学到新东西。
text.en: Losing is fine — you learn something new every time.

text.zh: 下次一定行！
text.en: You'll get it next time!

text.zh: 有人说最好的防守就是进攻。
text.en: They say the best defense is a good offense.

text.zh: 在塔防里...好像反过来才对？
text.en: In tower defense... isn't it the other way around?

text.zh: 喝水了吗？记得补充水分哦。
text.en: Had any water? Remember to stay hydrated!

text.zh: 弹跳攻击能打到后面的敌人，适合对付长队列。
text.en: Bounce attacks hit enemies in the back — great against long lines.

text.zh: 你说，敌人的世界里有没有「人防」游戏？
text.en: Do you think enemies have a "human defense" game?

text.zh: 就是...建敌人来突破塔的防线那种？
text.en: Like... spawn enemies to break through tower defenses?

text.zh: 战灵的能力充好了别忘了用，CD不等人的。
text.en: Use your Warden's ability when it's ready — cooldowns wait for no one.

text.zh: 做任何事都是一样的道理：
text.en: It's the same with anything in life:

text.zh: 与其追求完美，不如先把眼前的事做好。
text.en: Rather than chasing perfection, just do what's in front of you well.

text.zh: 分裂怪死的时候会变成小怪，要小心！
text.en: Splitters turn into smaller enemies when they die — watch out!

text.zh: 我在想一个很深刻的问题...
text.en: I'm pondering something really deep...

text.zh: 今天中午吃什么好呢？
text.en: What should I have for lunch today?

text.zh: 高强度的塔伤害更高，但别忽略攻速哦~
text.en: High Strength towers hit harder, but don't ignore attack speed~

text.zh: 旋转攻击能扫到周围所有敌人。
text.en: Spin attacks hit all enemies in range.

text.zh: 放在路中间效果拔群！
text.en: Place them in the middle of the path for max effect!

text.zh: 有时候什么都不做也是一种策略。
text.en: Sometimes doing nothing is a strategy too.

text.zh: 比如现在，我们就在等最好的时机。
text.en: Like right now — we're waiting for the perfect moment.

text.zh: 你是那种会反复挑战同一关的人吗？
text.en: Are you the type to replay the same level over and over?

text.zh: 我喜欢这种不服输的精神！
text.en: I love that never-give-up spirit!

text.zh: 也不知道什么样的阵容才是最强的...
text.en: I wonder what the strongest lineup really is...

text.zh: 是不是已经被你发现了呢？
text.en: Have you figured it out already?

text.zh: 你说，打完这关Boss之后...
text.en: Say, after we beat this Boss...

text.zh: 后面还会有什么在等着我们呢？
text.en: What do you think awaits us next?

text.zh: 你说，开发者自己能不能通关呀？
text.en: Think the developer can even beat their own game?

text.zh: 说不定他调了半天数值，自己还没打过。
text.en: Bet they spent hours tweaking stats and still can't clear it.

text.zh: 有没有试过全用同一种攻击方式？
text.en: Ever tried using only one attack style?

text.zh: 还是说...混搭才是你的风格？
text.en: Or... is mixing it up more your thing?

text.zh: 我总觉得有些能力组合在一起会特别厉害...
text.en: I feel like some ability combos could be insanely powerful...

text.zh: 就差一个人去验证了——比如你？
text.en: Just needs someone to test it — like you?

text.zh: 每张地图的地形都不一样。
text.en: Every map has different terrain.

text.zh: 同样的阵容换张图可能就不好使了哦~
text.en: The same lineup might not work on a different map~

text.zh: 你有没有想过只造一座塔就通关？
text.en: Ever thought about clearing with just one tower?

text.zh: 把所有资源砸一座塔上...超级强化！
text.en: Dump all resources into one tower... super powered!

text.zh: 不知道行不行，但想想就很刺激。
text.en: Not sure if it works, but sounds thrilling!

text.zh: 据说有人零损失通关了极难模式...
text.en: They say someone cleared Extreme mode with zero losses...

text.zh: 是传说吧？还是真有这种大佬？
text.en: Is that a legend? Or do such pros actually exist?

text.zh: 每种战灵的玩法完全不同呢。
text.en: Each Warden plays completely differently.

text.zh: 你最喜欢哪一个？都试过了吗？
text.en: Which one's your favorite? Tried them all?

text.zh: 减速加高攻...还是控制加范围...
text.en: Slow plus high damage... or crowd control plus AoE...

text.zh: 搭配这种事，越想越上头！
text.en: The more I think about combos, the more hooked I get!

text.zh: 后面的关卡敌人会越来越离谱的...
text.en: Enemies get crazier in later levels...

text.zh: 你准备好了吗？
text.en: Are you ready?

text.zh: 你发现了吗？有些敌人会给同伴加速。
text.en: Did you notice? Some enemies speed up their allies.

text.zh: 优先打掉它们，不然后面一大串就溜过去了！
text.en: Take them out first, or a whole pack will slip through!

text.zh: 如果你觉得太简单了...
text.en: If it feels too easy...

text.zh: 试试更高难度？我不会笑你的。
text.en: Try a higher difficulty? I won't laugh at you.
...Probably.

text.zh: 治疗型敌人会给同伴恢复血量。
text.en: Healer enemies restore their allies' HP.

text.zh: 集火它们！不然打了等于没打。
text.en: Focus fire on them! Otherwise all your damage is wasted.

text.zh: 你觉得这个游戏最难的地方是什么？
text.en: What's the hardest part of this game, you think?

text.zh: 我觉得是...选择。
text.en: I think it's... making choices.

text.zh: 建在哪，升哪座，选什么能力，全是选择。
text.en: Where to build, what to upgrade, which ability — all choices.

text.zh: 听说把道具攒到Boss波再用，效果翻倍？
text.en: I heard saving items for Boss waves doubles their value?

text.zh: 不是翻倍啦，但确实更值。
text.en: Not literally double, but definitely worth more.

text.zh: 换张没打过的地图试试？
text.en: Wanna try a map you haven't played yet?

text.zh: 新地图新挑战，说不定有惊喜！
text.en: New map, new challenge — might be a nice surprise!

text.zh: 塔的强度(Strength)决定一切。
text.en: A tower's Strength determines everything.

text.zh: 铺太多塔会稀释每座塔的成长哦~
text.en: Too many towers dilute each one's growth~

text.zh: 我偷偷观察了一下...
text.en: I've been watching quietly...

text.zh: 你好像有自己固定的打法了？
text.en: Looks like you've got your own go-to strategy?

text.zh: 要不要试试完全不同的策略？
text.en: Wanna try something completely different?

text.zh: 狂暴的敌人血少了会突然变快！
text.en: Berserk enemies suddenly speed up when low on HP!

text.zh: 千万别在低血量时让它们跑过去...
text.en: Don't let them slip through when they're low...

text.zh: 我有时候会想...如果我有自己的意识。
text.en: Sometimes I wonder... what if I had my own consciousness.

text.zh: 我会做什么呢？大概还是在这里陪你吧。
text.en: What would I do? Probably still be here with you.

text.zh: 这个游戏的代码里，好几千行都是关于我的。
text.en: Thousands of lines of code in this game are about me.

text.zh: 受宠若惊！
text.en: I'm flattered!

text.zh: 你看到的每一个像素...
text.en: Every pixel you see...

text.zh: 都是有人一点点调出来的。想想还挺浪漫的。
text.en: Was carefully crafted by someone. Kinda romantic, isn't it?

text.zh: 有一次测试的时候，我直接从屏幕上消失了...
text.en: Once during testing, I just vanished from the screen...

text.zh: 据说那天开发者加班到凌晨三点。
text.en: Heard the developer stayed up till 3 AM that day.

text.zh: 你知道吗？在你看不到的地方...
text.en: Did you know? Behind the scenes...

text.zh: 有个自动测试系统在反复打这个游戏。
text.en: There's an automated testing system playing this game non-stop.

text.zh: 它可不会心疼我。
text.en: It doesn't care about my feelings.

text.zh: 「Bug不是缺陷，是未被发现的特性」
text.en: "Bugs aren't defects — they're undiscovered features."

text.zh: ——某位程序员如是说。
text.en: — Said a programmer, once.

text.zh: 每次游戏更新，我都会偷偷祈祷：
text.en: Every time the game updates, I secretly pray:

text.zh: 这次别把我改没了...
text.en: Please don't patch me out this time...

text.zh: 我的台词都写在一个JSON文件里。
text.en: All my lines are stored in a JSON file.

text.zh: 不过你又看不到——哦等等，你不会真去找吧？
text.en: But you can't see it — wait, you're not actually going to look, are you?

text.zh: 你说设计师会不会配置错数值？
text.en: Think the designer might misconfigure some values?

text.zh: 万一哪个怪血量多了个零...
text.en: What if some enemy got an extra zero on its HP...

text.zh: 第一场胜利！恭喜你，指挥官！
text.en: First victory! Congratulations, Commander!

text.zh: 已经赢了5场了！越来越厉害了呢。
text.en: 5 wins already! You're getting better and better.

text.zh: 10连胜！你简直是天才指挥官！
text.en: 10 wins! You're a genius Commander!

text.zh: 击杀100个敌人了！小有成就。
text.en: 100 enemies down! Not bad at all.

text.zh: 500个击杀！敌人听到你的名字都会发抖。
text.en: 500 kills! Enemies tremble at your name.

text.zh: 1000个击杀！！传说级指挥官！
text.en: 1000 kills!! A legendary Commander!

text.zh: 嗯？需要什么帮助吗？
text.en: Hm? Need any help?

text.zh: 别戳我啦~
text.en: Stop poking me~

text.zh: 我在呢，有什么事？
text.en: I'm here, what's up?

text.zh: 嘿嘿，被你发现我在发呆了。
text.en: Hehe, you caught me spacing out.

text.zh: 又戳！你是不是很无聊？
text.en: Again! Are you bored or something?

text.zh: ...我也是。
text.en: ...Same here.

text.zh: 如果你戳我一百次，会不会解锁什么？
text.en: If you tap me 100 times, will something unlock?

text.zh: 答案是不会。但你可以试试。
text.en: The answer is no. But feel free to try.

text.zh: 我刚才在数屏幕上的像素...
text.en: I was counting the pixels on screen...

text.zh: 被你打断了！
text.en: And you interrupted me!

text.zh: 感谢你还记得我的存在！
text.en: Thanks for remembering I exist!

text.zh: 有心事吗？跟我说说？
text.en: Something on your mind? Wanna talk?

text.zh: ...虽然我只会说固定的台词。
text.en: ...Even though I can only say scripted lines.

text.zh: 戳戳戳...你手指不累吗？
text.en: Poke poke poke... Aren't your fingers tired?

text.zh: 早安~吃过早餐了吗？
text.en: Morning~ Had breakfast yet?

text.zh: 一日之计在于晨！今天也要加油！
text.en: A good day starts in the morning! Let's do our best!

text.zh: 早起的指挥官有虫...不对，有胜利！
text.en: The early Commander gets the worm... no wait, the victory!

text.zh: 午后时光~来一局轻松的？
text.en: Lazy afternoon~ How about a chill round?

text.zh: 下午好！精神还好吗？别犯困哦~
text.en: Good afternoon! Feeling awake? Don't doze off~

text.zh: 午后的阳光...最适合打塔防了！
text.en: Afternoon sunshine... perfect for tower defense!

text.zh: 晚上好~辛苦一天了，来放松吧。
text.en: Good evening~ Long day? Time to relax.

text.zh: 夜幕降临，正是战斗的好时机！
text.en: Night falls — the perfect time for battle!

text.zh: 晚上好！打两局再去休息吧~
text.en: Good evening! Play a couple rounds before bed~

text.zh: 深夜了...真的不睡了吗？
text.en: It's so late... Really not sleeping?

text.zh: 那我就陪你到最后一局吧。
text.en: Then I'll stay with you till the last round.

text.zh: 凌晨了还在打...你是夜猫子吧？
text.en: Playing past midnight... You're a night owl, huh?

text.zh: 嘘...小声点，别吵到其他人。
text.en: Shh... Keep it down, don't wake anyone.

text.zh: 我们偷偷打一局！
text.en: Let's sneak in one round!

text.zh: 半小时了~节奏刚刚好！
text.en: Half an hour in~ Perfect pace!

text.zh: 玩了三十分钟了，手感热了吧？
text.en: Thirty minutes in — warmed up yet?

text.zh: 整整一小时！站起来活动活动~
text.en: A whole hour! Get up and stretch~

text.zh: 一小时了，喝口水再继续？
text.en: One hour now — grab some water before continuing?

text.zh: 九十分钟了！你的眼睛还好吗？
text.en: Ninety minutes! How are your eyes holding up?

text.zh: 都快两小时了...真的要休息一下了！
text.en: Almost two hours... You really need a break!

text.zh: 我在这等着，不会跑的。
text.en: I'll be right here waiting. Not going anywhere.

text.zh: 首胜达成！开局大吉~
text.en: First win achieved! Off to a great start~

text.zh: 赢了！第一场总是最让人激动的！
text.en: You won! The first victory is always the most exciting!

text.zh: 五连胜！你已经上手了嘛~
text.en: Five wins! You've got the hang of it~

text.zh: 第五场胜利！继续冲！
text.en: Win number five! Keep it up!

text.zh: 十胜达成！你是真正的防线大师！
text.en: Ten wins achieved! You're a true defense master!

text.zh: 第十场胜利！没有你守不住的地图！
text.en: Victory number ten! No map can stand against you!

text.zh: 百杀达成！敌人闻风丧胆~
text.en: 100 kills! Enemies flee in terror~

text.zh: 消灭了100个敌人了！起飞！
text.en: 100 enemies wiped out! Let's go!

text.zh: 500击杀！你简直是移动要塞！
text.en: 500 kills! You're a walking fortress!

text.zh: 五百个了...敌人看到你应该会绕路。
text.en: Five hundred... Enemies would take a detour if they saw you.

text.zh: 千杀大佬！我为你鼓掌！
text.en: A thousand kills! I'm clapping for you!

text.zh: 一千击杀！这就是传说中的杀神吧！
text.en: One thousand kills! This must be the legendary slayer!

text.zh: 发呆中？还是在想策略？
text.en: Spacing out? Or planning your strategy?

text.zh: 嗨~我在这里哦，别忘了我！
text.en: Hey~ I'm right here, don't forget about me!

text.zh: 好安静...要不要来聊聊天？
text.en: So quiet... Wanna chat?
